name: feature-planner
title: Feature planner
description: Twice a week: turns ideas a maintainer labelled needs-spec into specified issues and sub-issues, and proposes missing features once a week. Writes issues, never code.
notes: The business side of the crew (product owner). It replaces the production feature-builder routine, which developed ready issues and is now covered by issue-developer. Add the needs-spec label to an idea to get a specification.
